title: Palak's Travel Scrapbook & Wandering Diaries
subtitle: Candid memories, road trips, mountain trails, temple bells, and serene skies

chapters.name: Pachmarhi & Satpura Ridges
chapters.tagline: Queen of Satpura — misty peaks, cascading waterfalls & ancient cave shrines
chapters.narrative: Waking up at 5:30 AM to catch the sea of clouds rolling below Dhoopgarh. The scent of pine and wet earth after a sudden mountain shower. Climbing 1,300+ steps up to Chauragarh with bells echoing in the mist. Pure serenity.

photos.title: Dhoopgarh Golden Dawn
photos.caption: Watching amber sunlight break over the endless Satpura ridges from the highest point in Madhya Pradesh.

photos.title: Misty Morning in the Valley
photos.caption: Early morning fog clinging to pine canopy. The air was crisp, clean, and carrying pine fragrances.

photos.title: Apsara Vihar Natural Pool
photos.caption: Clear turquoise mountain water gushing into a natural rock pool. Freezing cold but magical.

photos.title: Bee Falls Roaring Cascade
photos.caption: The force of the falling water buzzing like bees in the gorge. Worth the steep climb back up!

photos.title: Chauragarh Pilgrimage Trail
photos.caption: The holy climb surrounded by thousands of brass trishuls left by devotees across centuries.

photos.title: Satpura Pine Woods
photos.caption: Tall slender pine trees framing the walking trails. Peaceful silence interrupted only by bird song.

photos.title: Jatashankar Cave Cliffs
photos.caption: Enormous overhang rock cliffs sheltering naturally formed stalagmite shivlingams.

photos.title: Monsoon Green Ridges
photos.caption: When the monsoon drenches the hills in velvety moss and jade greens that look straight out of a painting.

chapters.name: Tamil Nadu Heritage & Food
chapters.tagline: Dravidian architecture, temple towers, filter kaapi & banana leaf feasts
chapters.narrative: Intricate gopurams reaching toward azure blue skies, the scent of fresh jasmine flowers, sizzling ghee roast dosas on cast iron tavas, and steaming brass tumblers of dark chicory filter coffee.

photos.title: Meenakshi Amman Gopuram
photos.caption: Thousands of sculpted deities and mythical creatures rising high into the tropical morning sun.

photos.title: Crispy Ghee Roast Masala Dosa
photos.caption: Crispy golden wafer-thin crust filled with spiced potatoes, accompanied by coconut and fiery tomato chutney.

photos.title: Fluffy Steamed Idli & Sambar
photos.caption: Cloud-soft idlis bathing in rich drumstick sambar garnished with fresh curry leaves and mustard seeds.

photos.title: Brass Tumbler Filter Kaapi
photos.caption: Poured from height into the brass davarah to create velvety froth. Best drink in the world.

chapters.name: Moon, Stars & Cloudscapes
chapters.tagline: Looking up at celestial wonder, golden hours, and quiet starry nights
chapters.narrative: Every time the sky turns pastel or a luminous full moon floats over silhouetted tree branches, time slows down. I keep a visual log of skies that made me pause and breathe.

photos.title: Amber Golden Hour Clouds
photos.caption: When the sun dips low and lights the cloud bellies with vibrant molten gold and honey tones.

photos.title: Dramatic Monsoon Storm Clouds
photos.caption: Heavy bruised clouds rolling in right before the heavens opened. The air smelled of petrichor.

photos.title: Pastel Pink Twilight
photos.caption: Cotton-candy clouds against soft violet evening gradient. Feels peaceful and gentle.

photos.title: Silver Sunbeams Through Clouds
photos.caption: Crepuscular rays streaming down like ladders of divine light over the distant horizon.

photos.title: Delicate Cirrus Feathers
photos.caption: High altitude ice-crystal cirrus clouds painted against a deep azure backdrop.

photos.title: Full Moon Floating Through Pines
photos.caption: A bright silver pearl illuminating the silent pine silhouettes on a crisp clear night.

photos.title: Crescent Moon at Twilight
photos.caption: A razor-thin silver crescent hanging in deep ultramarine blue right as the first stars appear.

photos.title: Moonrise Above Mountain Crest
photos.caption: Warm yellow harvest moon climbing above the dark mountain silhouette.

photos.title: Quiet Starlit Galaxy
photos.caption: Thousands of twinkling diamonds and the faint dust lane of the Milky Way over silent hills.

chapters.name: Rivers, Waterfalls & Reflections
chapters.tagline: Crystal mountain streams, soothing rapids, rain ripples and serene lakes
chapters.narrative: There is healing magic in running water. The sound of pebbles tumbling under clear streams, the mist of waterfalls on your face, and the glassy reflections of tranquil lakes.

photos.title: Mountain Stream on Mossy Pebbles
photos.caption: Crystal clear water filtering through smooth river rocks and emerald moss cushions.

photos.title: Hidden Forest Waterfall Cascade
photos.caption: Secret waterfall cascading down tiered rock ledges into a pristine natural pool.

photos.title: Mirror Reflection on Calm Lake
photos.caption: Glass-like lake surface reflecting golden dawn clouds and surrounding hill silhouettes perfectly.

photos.title: Rushing Rapids in Stone Canyon
photos.caption: Roaring white-water rapids carving ancient smooth grooves through red sandstone bedrock.

photos.title: Raindrop Ripples on Pond
photos.caption: Gentle monsoon raindrops creating intricate overlapping circular ripples on water.

chapters.name: Enchanted Forests & Woodland Paths
chapters.tagline: Golden canopy sunbeams, ancient gnarly roots, and peaceful walking trails
chapters.narrative: Walking through dense forest where towering trees filter the morning light into bright golden beams. Nature in its undisturbed, quiet, and timeless elegance.

photos.title: Morning Sunbeams Through Pine Forest
photos.caption: God-rays slicing through the morning mist between tall teak and pine trunks.

photos.title: Ancient Moss-Covered Tree Roots
photos.caption: Gnarled roots gripping the earth like living sculptures covered in vibrant green moss.

photos.title: Looking Up to the Canopy
photos.caption: Tree crowns creating natural shyness patterns against the pale autumn sky.

photos.title: Winding Woodland Trail
photos.caption: A soft dirt path curving into the mystery of the quiet woods. Where will it lead?

photos.title: Golden Autumn Leaves in Light
photos.caption: Warm golden leaves glowing translucent in the afternoon sun before fluttering to the ground.
